description: This file defines the PdfSoftMask class, which represents a PDF soft mask as part of the PdfSharp library. It includes properties and keys for managing PDF soft mask specifications within the context of PDF document processing.

classes.name: PdfSoftMask
classes.description: Represents a PDF soft mask, inheriting from PdfDictionary, encapsulating PDF soft mask properties and keys.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for the PdfSoftMask dictionary, including type, method, source graphic, backdrop color, and transfer function.

methods.name: PdfSoftMask
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new PdfSoftMask object for a given PdfDocument and setting its type to Mask.
